Team Sahabhaav took good care of my 76-year-old, diabetic, bed-bound mother with multiple health issues. Excellent nurses whose meticulous care made a huge difference. featured_reviews.name: Satya Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our parents recently spent a short stay at Sahabhaav, and we were deeply impressed by the warmth, attentiveness, and professionalism of the entire team. The facility is modern, cheerful, and comfortable, the food was excellent, and the social activities helped our parents feel engaged and included. Minor issues were addressed promptly, creating a sense of ease throughout their stay. What stood out most is the genuine care that defines Sahabhaav. It is clear that for Dr Mini Panicker and her team, this work is truly a calling. Details on different aspects follow.

Exceptional Team and Warmth:
The staff's engagement made a tremendous difference. Our parents repeatedly said, "Anything we asked for, they got for us," which reflects how well they were looked after.

Social Interaction and Activities:
The range of activities, from casual storytelling sessions to aarti and seated garba, added real value. These thoughtful experiences help seniors feel connected and uplifted, especially those with limited mobility.

Facilities and Ambience:
The interiors have been newly renovated with a modern, airy, cheerful aesthetic that creates a welcoming atmosphere. The bathrooms are well designed with modern fittings and pleasant colors.

Food and Dining:
The meals were another highlight. Dad enjoyed the variety of vegetarian dishes, lentils, yogurt, buttermilk, and the occasional chicken. Mom, who is usually a selective eater, also managed very well, which speaks to the quality of the food and the adaptability of tastes.

Freedom From Household Responsibilities:
For Mom, the relief from day to day household tasks was meaningful. She appreciated being cared for rather than needing to manage everything herself.

Responsiveness:
As with any new place and the specific needs of individual guests, minor issues can arise, but what stood out was how promptly and proactively the Sahabhaav team addressed them.

Overall Experience:
Our parents' stay was overwhelmingly positive, and we are grateful for the compassion and professionalism shown throughout. Sahabhaav offers a warm, community driven environment that places seniors' comfort and dignity at the center. We deeply appreciate the efforts of everyone at Sahabhaav and wish the facility continued success and its residents the very best.

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent and Kind people. Got male nurse (same day) as per medical history of patient. All documentation of Nurse and qualification was given before hand. featured_reviews.review_text: Best providers for care takers, nurses. Very prompt, well updated and staff was very caring. Special mention for Karuna who is available at all times.
